description: Read a release's canonical delivery status: its overall state, current and historical delivery predicates, and one current state per outlet. The API owns all queue-history interpretation. A release outside your account is indistinguishable from an unknown release (`RELEASE_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`).

response_format.description: 'concise' (default) keeps high-signal fields and ids; 'detailed' is the verbatim response.

name: get_delivery_queue
title: Get release delivery status
